(2) Any new statement implying runtime secrecy or correct computation beyond T-056, or any production-qualification claim. The base text says the deadline and serving-profile catalogs are empty and no catalog entry is activated. (3) Any change to the description of media decoding caps (lines 623-627) or temp-file handling that relates to T-050. (4) Doc-versus-code drift where the doc relaxes a security-relevant gate, such as audio rejection or cache-scope rules. No cross-file interactions can be assessed from base text alone.
